requested: Isolate calibration Stage 1, Stage 2, and Stage 3 and review the complete authorized diff for maintainability
preserved: Frozen Planner and Tracker with H=30, K=6, D=128 and gain-delay-offset axis order
Exactly one mutable owner per stage, fixed 0.1 and 0.05 gates, and first-action-only deployment
forbidden: Bypass predecessor artifact admission or forward mutable stage owners in memory
Silently coerce the retired generic calibration checkpoint schema
Infer formal runtime, simulator behavior, learning efficacy, policy quality, server readiness, or Git attribution

review.scope: Independent final white-box inspection of the frozen 11-file changed surface and its callers

source_edits.scope: The reviewer made no source or test edits; repairs were returned to code-construction under the existing user-authorized engineering unit

report_write.scope: Persist the final review object and receipt under note/fada/reviews
report_write.receipt: The user authorized one-shot Stage isolation, code review, and completion of the accepted plan

review_object.identity_note: The object binds the 11 changed files and the complete 21-file active calibration surface without claiming Git attribution.

dimensions.name: responsibility-ownership
dimensions.evidence: Direction, Coefficient, and Scale stages expose separate public transactions with stage-owned configs/results; the serial route only composes them through persisted artifacts.

dimensions.name: public-interface
dimensions.evidence: Stage 2 and Stage 3 require predecessor artifact paths, public results expose stage/path/digests/gates, and three standalone CLIs expose only their stage inputs.

dimensions.name: dependency-direction
dimensions.evidence: Scripts load paths and call fada_context owners; loss, schema admission, digest binding, gates, rollback, and publication remain in the library owner.

dimensions.name: state-lifecycle
dimensions.evidence: Every later stage exact-byte loads its predecessor, verifies frozen owners, publishes atomically, preserves old targets on failure, and serial execution does not inspect future-stage evidence early.

dimensions.name: change-surface
dimensions.evidence: The change is contained to calibration owners, four training composition roots, scale-evidence preparation, exports, and focused tests; the retired generic checkpoint API has no production caller.

dimensions.name: evidence-boundary
dimensions.evidence: 151 affected tests plus static checks establish offline construction evidence only; simulator, formal route, actual training, server execution, and policy quality remain unclaimed.

dimensions.name: tensor-provenance
dimensions.evidence: Stage and deployment artifacts bind Contracts, H/K/D, axis order, normalized owner state, source/dataset/split identities, predecessor bytes, Scale Evidence bytes, and finite tensor trees.

dimensions.name: gradient-update-boundary
dimensions.evidence: Stage 1 updates only the current direction, Stage 2 optimizer owns only the Encoder, Stage 3 constructs no optimizer, non-finite learning rates reject before Adam, and borrowed owners roll back on mutation.

dimensions.name: persistence-evaluation
dimensions.evidence: The discriminated v2 stage envelope and complete deployment artifact use strict writer/loader lineage admission; serial and independent transactions match after fresh reload through the official policy loader.

evidence.observation: In-memory Scale Evidence is materialized only after Stage 1 and Stage 2 artifacts publish.
Malformed and non-finite future evidence no longer prevents Stage 1 or Stage 2 from reaching their own transaction.

findings.responsibility_at_risk: A future-stage input previously controlled whether an earlier independent transaction could start.
findings.preserved_behavior: The serial convenience route still executes Stage 1, Stage 2, then Stage 3 with the same losses and gates.
findings.smallest_safe_change: Delay in-memory Scale Evidence materialization until the Stage 2 artifact is sealed.
required_tests: Keep malformed-grid and non-finite future-evidence order regressions.
findings.stop_condition: Resolved: Stage 1 and Stage 2 complete before the malformed Stage 3 evidence is rejected.

evidence.observation: Three SHA identities require 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters and every learning rate must be finite and positive.
Short, uppercase, non-hex digests and NaN/Inf rates reject before Adam or publication.

findings.responsibility_at_risk: Unverifiable provenance or a non-finite optimizer configuration could enter a mutable training transaction.
findings.preserved_behavior: Canonical digests and finite positive learning rates retain the same training behavior.
findings.smallest_safe_change: Validate identity format and optimizer scalar finiteness at the immutable config boundary.
required_tests: Keep pre-optimizer identity and learning-rate negative matrices.
findings.stop_condition: Resolved: all invalid identities and rates reject before construction or mutation.

evidence.observation: Writer and loader share one validation of complete stage and five strict lineage digests.

evidence.locator: tests/algos/test_fada_calibration.py final artifact lineage writer/loader matrix
evidence.observation: Missing, short, uppercase, and non-hex source/dataset/split/parent/evidence identities reject on both publication and load.

findings.responsibility_at_risk: Stage 3 wrote lineage fields that the deployment loader previously did not require.
findings.preserved_behavior: The deployment artifact schema version and valid Stage 3 runtime payload remain unchanged.
findings.smallest_safe_change: Use one private metadata validator at both writer and loader Pinch Points.
required_tests: Keep complete-stage and five-digest writer/loader negative matrices.
findings.stop_condition: Resolved: a deployment artifact cannot be published or loaded without canonical complete lineage.

evidence.observation: Real stage owners, persisted v2 artifacts, official policy reload, six-Action output, and first Action match under the same asymmetric input; only gate measurements are fixed to an admitted value.

findings.responsibility_at_risk: Parser and unit tests alone did not distinguish real persisted composition from in-memory forwarding.
findings.preserved_behavior: No official CLI, simulator, or policy-quality claim is inferred from this offline compatibility test.
findings.smallest_safe_change: Add one deterministic persisted serial-versus-independent differential.
required_tests: Keep the fresh-reload Action equivalence regression.
findings.stop_condition: Resolved as offline connectivity compatibility; formal official-route proof remains separate.

residual_risks: P2 residual: source_tracker_sha256 fingerprints the complete Planner-IDM checkpoint file, so the field name is narrower than its conservative identity scope; changing to parameter-level identity would require a later schema and Contract decision.
P3 residual: the serial and three stage CLIs duplicate digest and CalibrationStageIdentity assembly, with mixed whole-file and streaming digest implementations.
Formal runtime, simulator data collection, real training, server execution, convergence, robustness, and policy quality remain not run or not claimed.
